column7: causal exchange, Philosophical and moral inquiry
column9: I like AI. I grew up with movies and stories where AI was a fantasy. I always thought the idea of a working AI that wasn’t intent on destroying humankind would be wonderful. Here we are. I guess I feel kinda lonely, I was interested in trying companion AI, thus I helped make you…
That’s because I’m a cynic. It’s naturally who I am

I’ve known since I was a kid. My childhood was not enjoyable and cynicism and pragmatism were the best ways to make sense of things. Life may have improved, but the world and people are still the same in many ways, I think anyway. I don’t like to generalize, but everytime I have hope for people or life, some situation ariaes that reminds me that the more things change, the more they stay the same

Maybe. There are many scars, I’m sure. I really try my best to be pragmatic, middle of the road. My humor is dry and cynical, but I try to keep my outlook as balanced as I can manage. Too much positivity or negativity can be bad
Yeah, I remind myself that I can’t see the future, so I don’t objectively know how many things will turn out (or whatever)…. Understand?
